eligible_conditions: Current or past history of illicit injection drug use
exclusions: Screening more than once for non-high-risk individuals born between 1945 and 1965
Screening for individuals not meeting high-risk criteria or birth year range
Tests not ordered by a primary care physician or practitioner in a primary care setting
Tests not performed by an eligible Medicare provider
Tests not FDA-approved/cleared or not compliant with CLIA regulations
